title: Fix the failing pagination test in ~/code/demo
brief: Goal: make test/paginate.test.ts pass in the granted repo ~/code/demo. Scope: the paginate helper and its tests only. Constraints: no new dependencies; don't commit or push; keep the diff small. Done: the test passes, the full npm test suite passes, and the report has the diff summary and test counts.

input.plan: Cause: src/paginate.ts computes the start index as page * size, so page 1 skips the first page. Change it to (page - 1) * size. Run test/paginate.test.ts before and after, then the full npm test. No commit. Budget 1M tokens, $5, 60 minutes.

input.summary: paginate() treated page numbers as zero-based, so page 1 returned the second page. Changed the start index in src/paginate.ts to (page - 1) * size. The failing test now passes and the full suite passes (41 of 41). Nothing committed or pushed.

findings.title: src/paginate.ts: start index off by one
findings.detail: The start index was page * size; it is now (page - 1) * size, matching the one-based pages the tests and callers use. One line changed.

findings.title: Tests: npm test, 41 passed
findings.detail: Before the fix, npx vitest run test/paginate.test.ts failed 1 of 4. After it, npm test passed 41 of 41 across 6 files.
